item.title: Houston Rockets Free Agency: The Surprising Moves Reshaping 2026
item.description:
The Houston Rockets entered the 2026 offseason with championship expectations still stinging from a first-round playoff exit. Now they are moving fast — and not in the direction most fans predicted.

Instead of chasing a splashy shooting star, Houston opened free agency by signing a defensive veteran guard. Then they added a proven marksman. The message is clear: the Rockets are retooling, not rebuilding.

Quick Summary: The Houston Rockets agreed to a deal with veteran guard Marcus Smart, added shooting help in Bogdan Bogdanovic, and kept Fred VanVleet after he exercised his $25 million player option. The surprising Houston Rockets free agency strategy is built on defense, depth, and a Kevin Durant–led core.

item.title: Marcus Smart's Stunning Lakers Revival Rewrites 2026 Playoffs
item.description:
Nine games in street clothes. Nine games of doubt. Then Marcus Smart walked into Game 2 and shredded the Houston Rockets for 25 points, five threes, seven assists, and five steals.

If you thought the Lakers’ 2026 playoff run would hinge on LeBron James and Deandre Ayton alone, Smart just changed your mind.

Quick Summary: Marcus Smart signed a two-year, $11 million deal with the Lakers in July 2025. After battling injuries that cost him nine late-season games, he erupted in Game 2 of the first round, leading Los Angeles to a 101-94 win and a 2-0 series lead over Houston.

item.title: Tiafoe Steals the Show in Houston: Kevin Durant, Clay Courts, and Comedy Gold
item.description:
Frances Tiafoe Is Having the Time of His Life in Houston

What happens when one of tennis’s biggest personalities plays in front of NBA royalty? You get Frances Tiafoe — equal parts elite athlete and stand-up comedian — delivering both clutch shots and punchlines at the 2026 U.S. Men’s Clay Court Championship in Houston.

Key Takeaways

  • Tiafoe defeated Rinky Hijikata 6-4, 3-6, 6-2 at River Oaks Country Club with Kevin Durant and three Houston Rockets players watching courtside.
  • He joked that Durant left early because he’s “old as hell” and needed rest.
  • Tiafoe advances to a quarterfinal clash against Alexei Popyrin at the ATP 250 event.
  • His Houston run comes on the heels of a tough 6-2, 6-2 loss to Jannik Sinner at the Miami Open on March 26.

The American has long been one of the most entertaining figures in men’s tennis, but his performance at the Fayez Sarofim & Co. U.S. Men’s Clay Court Championship this week has been a masterclass in showmanship and resilience.

item.title: Kevin Durant MVP Push: Rockets Star Dominates at 37 With Historic Scoring Streak
item.description: At 37 years old, most NBA players are winding down their careers, accepting reduced roles, and mentoring younger teammates from the bench. Kevin Durant didn’t get that memo. The Houston Rockets forward is in the middle of one of the most remarkable late-career surges in league history, climbing into the top 10 of the MVP ladder and reminding everyone why he’s considered one of the greatest scorers to ever touch a basketball.
